description_en: Retrieves paginated standalone inspection reports on a specified user's non-scheduled tasks
description_zh: 查询指定用户下所有非定时任务的单独巡检报告列表，支持分页
name: GetStandAloneReports

parameters.help_en: The start of the query's time range. The time must be in UTC and in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ` format. If omitted, no start time filter is applied
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间过滤（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ），不传则不过滤
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the query's time range. The time must be in UTC and in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ` format. If omitted, no end time filter is applied
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间过滤（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ），不传则不过滤
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default: 20. Maximum: 100
parameters.name: page_size

v1_parameters.help_en: The end of the query's time range. The time must be in UTC and in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ` format. If omitted, no end time filter is applied
v1_parameters.help_zh: 结束时间过滤（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ），不传则不过滤
v1_parameters.name: EndTime

v1_parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The default value is 1
v1_parameters.name: PageNumber

v1_parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default: 20. Maximum: 100
v1_parameters.name: PageSize

v1_parameters.help_en: The start of the query's time range. The time must be in UTC and in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ` format. If omitted, no start time filter is applied
v1_parameters.help_zh: 开始时间过滤（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ），不传则不过滤
v1_parameters.name: StartTime
